Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Global Mainframe DB2 LUW team. This is not a typical application development role; we are looking for a \"under-the-hood\" expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between NoSQL and Relational environments.

As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.

What You Will Do

  • Core Administration: Perform deep-dive backend management of DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
  • Environment Management: Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
  • Modernization & Migration: Lead the charge in migrating data from NoSQL to Relational databases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
  • Cloud & NoSQL: Manage tasks related to AWS RDS and NoSQL platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Automation & Compliance: Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
  • Performance Tuning: Act as the subject matter expert for advanced SQL tuning and database optimization.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory.
  • Mainframe DB2 LUW
  • Expertise in DB2 LUW: Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. NoSQL).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Amazon RDS and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced Tuning: Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
  • Location: Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.


Hikvision possesses the world's largest R&D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision’s customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.


Business Development Manager – Industrial Market


Country： Brazil

The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.

The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:


•Great business sense and market sense

•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market

•Great communication skills

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•A positive attitude

•Great negotiation skills

•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity


Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:


•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys

•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points

•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users

•Presentation of the solution to potential customers

•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.

•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team

•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.

•Assist consultants to specify projects

•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.

•Prepare reports required by the management.


Your Profile:


•Experience in the industrial market.

•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.

•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.

•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•Strong communication skills in English，both oral and written

•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Systems Analyst – Application Support
description:
Position: Systems Analyst – Application Support (Agribusiness)


Professional Profile: Experienced professional in system support, business analysis, problem-solving, and user assistance. Results-oriented, with a client- and business-focused approach.


Main Responsibilities

  • Provide support for applications related to agribusiness and tax document messaging (SEFAZ).
  • Analyze and identify bugs, operational failures, and incident root causes.
  • Log and report bugs, as well as suggest process and system improvements.
  • Develop queries and reports in PL/SQL (low and medium complexity).
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams for joint problem resolution.
  • Manage service priorities according to urgency and impact.
  • Work aligned with project methodologies and client guidelines.


Behavioral Competencies

  • Customer focus
  • Good communication
  • Proactivity
  • Teamwork
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Meeting deadlines with quality
  • Risk identification and mitigation
  • Organization and prioritization


Languages

  • Intermediate English (emphasis on reading and writing); desirable comprehension and conversation.


Availability

• Availability to work night shifts on a 12x36 rotation, according to operational needs.

description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Assistente de marketing PCD
description:
Assistente de marketing - exclusivo PCD


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa apaixonada por marketing, organizada e com vontade de aprender, para atuar como Assistente de Marketing PCD em um ambiente dinâmico, multicultural e com atuação em toda a América Latina


Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, transita bem entre diferentes frentes de marketing e quer crescer na área, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na execução de campanhas de marketing digital (B2C e B2B);
  • Dar suporte na gestão e atualização de conteúdos para redes sociais;
  • Auxiliar em estratégias de SEO (otimização de conteúdos, palavras-chave, etc.);
  • Apoiar na criação e revisão de textos (posts, e-mails, landing pages);
  • Acompanhar métricas básicas de campanhas e gerar relatórios simples;
  • Dar suporte às demandas do time de marketing LATAM;
  • Organizar materiais, cronogramas e fluxos de comunicação com áreas internas;
  • Apoiar em ações de branding e campanhas institucionais.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Interesse em marketing digital, redes sociais e SEO;
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas como Google Analytics, Excel e plataformas de redes sociais;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização;


O que buscamos:

  • Perfil proativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente multicultural;
  • Interesse em atuar com diferentes países da América Latina.


Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD);
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: Comercial (segunda a sexta-feira).

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
Responsibilities

  • Meet quarterly and annual revenue goals according to the sales plan through a deep understanding of TopOn’s products and ad inventory.
  • You will interface, negotiate, and develop high-impact relationships with mobile game & app developers to build business partnerships and support company growth.
  • Develop and maintain excellent relationships with clients; ensure continuing relationships and an effective flow of information to deliver business objectives.
  • Coordinate with the internal team to ensure and resolve sales-related issues.
  • Conduct industry research for competition benchmarking and to identify new market trends and opportunities.
  • Represent TopOn at industry events, trade shows and meetings with partners & potential clients.


Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in sales, business, and customer management.
  • A track record of over-achieving against defined metrics would be preferred.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of the mobile advertising ecosystem and SDKs.
  • Ability of multi-threaded work, self-organized and proactive with attention to detail.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, start-up environment and ability to perform under stress.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.

title: Consultor SAP MM
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP MM para atuar em projetos estratégicos e sustentação de processos em ambiente industrial. A atuação envolverá melhorias e suporte nos módulos SAP MM com interface direta com áreas de Suprimentos, Logística e Operações. O candidato deve ter conhecimento em processos de compras, gestão de estoque, MRP , inventário e integrações logísticas, incluindo alçadas de aprovações. É essencial ter experiência ou vivência em SAP EWM apoiando processos de armazenagem, movimentação e controle de estoque. O levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, desenho funcional e especificação técnica são partes importantes do trabalho, assim como o acompanhamento de integrações com outros módulos como FI, CO, SD e PP . Também é necessário atuar nas integrações com sistemas legados, fretes, importação e demais sistemas industriais, oferecendo suporte a testes integrados, go live e estabilização.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Ter pós-graduação completa é um diferencial relevante, assim como conhecimento funcional em EWM . Além disso, vivência em ambiente industrial, um perfil analítico, proativo e com boa comunicação são desejáveis. Capacidade de atuar próximo às áreas de negócio com visão de processo ponta a ponta é muito valorizada. Conhecimento em ABAP será considerado um diferencial relevante.


Resumo dos requisitos: SAP MM , SAP EWM , MRP , FI , CO , SD , PP , ABAP .

title: Coordenador de Order To Cash
description:
Coordenador (a) de Order To Cash | Híbrido - São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash) . Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. O papel exige forte capacidade estratégica, mas também disposição para atuar no operacional quando necessário, sendo um verdadeiro backup do time . O desafio principal é gestão de pessoas , com foco em engajamento, crescimento e melhoria contínua dos processos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe , promovendo autonomia e direcionamento.
  • Estruturar processos e implementar melhorias, incluindo planos de contingência.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica, garantindo suporte operacional quando necessário.
  • Importante conhecer todo processo operacional para gerenciar todo o ciclo Order to Cash , incluindo:
  • Cadastro e registro de clientes (novos e recorrentes).
  • Análise de crédito e definição de condições de pagamento.
  • Faturamento e emissão de boletos (PIX, boleto bancário).
  • Configuração de formas de pagamento no SAP.
  • Conciliação bancária, baixa de recebíveis e títulos.
  • Cálculo de PDD e análise da saúde do contas a receber.
  • Apoiar atividades fiscais e contábeis relacionadas ao processo OTC.
  • Propor e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores para gestão da área.
  • Garantir comunicação eficaz com áreas internas (ex.: força de vendas) e clientes.
  • Participar do fechamento contábil mensal.


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Excel avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência sólida em processos OTC, análise de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento em SAP (configuração e operação).
  • Noções fiscais e contábeis para interação com áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Power BI / Power Query (não prioritário).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Formação superior completa (desejável pós-graduação).


Competências Comportamentais


  • Perfil autônomo , organizado e proativo.
  • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Comunicação clara e interpessoal positivo.
  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução.
  • Senso de urgência e habilidade para lidar com desafios.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes com crescimento acelerado .
  • Histórico de implementação de melhorias e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Espanhol (desejável).

title: Email & Retention Marketer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,400 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a data-driven Part-Time Email Marketer  to own the end-to-end retention strategy for two sister companies: a visual, custom-framing e-commerce site and a B2B wholesale moulding supplier.


You will be responsible for turning one-time buyers into repeat customers (D2C) and nurturing long-term professional relationships with artists, photographers, and businesses (B2B).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lifecycle Strategy:  Audit and rebuild automated \"flows\" for both brands (Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Win-back, and Post-Purchase).
  • Segmentation:  Create distinct \"Pro\" vs. \"Consumer\" segments to ensure B2B leads (photographers/galleries) receive different messaging than one-off home decor customers.
  • Campaign Management:  Manage the weekly calendar for both brands, including promotional campaigns for the e-commerce brand and industry-specific insights and nurture content for the wholesale business.
  • A/B Testing:  Constantly experiment with subject lines, send times, and CTA layouts to optimize Open Rates and Click-Through Rates.
  • Performance Reporting:  Track and report on Email-Attributed Revenue and List Growth monthly.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Platform Expertise:  3+ years of advanced proficiency in e-commerce email marketing platforms is a must.
  • Copywriting:  Ability to toggle between \"Inspiring & Aesthetic\" (D2C) and \"Professional & Direct\" (B2B).
  • Design Lite:  Proficiency with visual design tools to create or edit email templates that align with the brand identity.
  • B2B Experience:  Experience with \"Sales Enablement\" style emails (plain-text, personal feel) meant to drive inquiries for high-volume wholesale orders.
  • Data Literacy:  Deep understanding of how to use email data to inform the wider growth strategy.


Bonus Points:

  • Experience in the home decor, photography, or art industries.
  • Understanding of SMS marketing integration.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive retention and growth strategies for a fast-evolving e-commerce and wholesale business.


Commitment: Part-Time (around 10-15 hours a week), Long-term, Overlapping with PST working hours.


*Please note our partner is only looking for dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Base24 EPS Software Developer
description:
Base24 EPS Software Developer

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: PJ

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional motivado(a) e detalhista para atuar como Base24 EPS Software Developer para integrar a equipe do nosso cliente no setor de tecnologia de pagamento. Nesta função, você contribuirá com a navegação na estrutura de configuração do Base24, fornecimento de expertise técnica para parceiros de negócios, e manutenção de relações produtivas com grupos internos e externos.

Responsabilidades

  • Navegar pela estrutura de configuração do Base24 usando o cliente UI.
  • Fornecer expertise técnica para parceiros de negócios, explicando o potencial do sistema para expansão futura ou melhorias.
  • Trabalhar de perto com fornecedores externos para coordenar a resolução de problemas em diferentes plataformas.
  • Manter relações produtivas com grupos e organizações internas e externas.

Requisitos

  • Base24 EPS arquitetura e estrutura de módulos
  • Scripting Base24 EPS
  • Arquitetura Base24 Classic
  • Princípios de autorização ATM e POS
  • Conhecimento operacional do produto WebGate
  • Protocolos de rede TCP/IP
  • NonStop Batchcom, SCF, FUP, TACL, comandos EMS e navegação
  • Utilitário ACI NCPCOM, comandos e princípios operacionais
  • Configuração de rede Base24 XPNET
  • Programação em C
  • Habilidades de escrita de macros e scripts TACL
  • Procedimento Armazenado
  • Conceitos de EMV, verificação de cartão, segurança de PIN
  • 5-7 anos de experiência relevante em desenvolvimento de software, especificamente com sistemas Base24.
  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada.

Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de saúde do sistema
  • Conhecimento das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis

Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa!

A SGF Global é uma provedora líder de soluções especializadas em talentos, dedicada a conectar profissionais altamente qualificados com oportunidades em diversos setores. Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades.

Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo na melhor posição para ter sucesso. Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos. Fique por dentro de todas as oportunidades, a qualquer momento — mesmo em movimento.

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend (Python) Sr.

Desenvolvedor experiente que construirá a espinha dorsal da aplicação, garantindo que os serviços de suporte ao assistente de IA sejam escaláveis, seguros e de alta performance.

Será responsável por desenhar a arquitetura de microsserviços, gerenciar bancos de dados e criar as APIs que conectarão o frontend e os agentes de IA com os sistemas de backend.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos Necessários:

Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, etc).

Arquitetura e Cloud: Sólida experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços, conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e implantação em ambientes de nuvem (Openshift, AWS, GCP ou Azure).

Bancos de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, DB2, etc) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, etc), incluindo modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas.

APIs e Mensageria: Expertise no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e integração MCP. Conhecimento em mensageria usando Kafka.

Boas Práticas: Domínio de Git, práticas de CI/CD e escrita de testes unitários e de integração. Metodologias: Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Conhecimento mínimo em Java desejável.


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Arquitetura de TI Especialista
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Vaga Arquitetura de TI Especialista


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:




Responsabilidades:

• Projetar, documentar e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções tecnológicas, garantindo alinhamento com as estratégias de negócio e padrões corporativos.

• Apoiar o desenho de soluções integradas, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, performance e interoperabilidade.

• Elaborar artefatos técnicos como diagramas de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e especificações de alto nível.

• Avaliar tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas que suportem as necessidades de negócio e TI.

• Atuar como ponte entre times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e áreas de negócio.

• Participar de análises de viabilidade técnica e estimativas de esforço em novos projetos e demandas.

• Apoiar a governança de arquitetura, zelando pela padronização e aderência aos princípios da empresa.

• Contribuir para a evolução de arquiteturas legadas, promovendo modernização e transformação digital.

• Elaborar a arquitetura de soluções para novos projetos e evoluções de sistemas existentes.

• Criar e manter atualizados os artefatos técnicos relacionados à arquitetura (diagramas, especificações, modelos de integração).

• Apoiar as áreas de negócio e desenvolvimento na definição de soluções tecnológicas.

• Realizar avaliação técnica de propostas, tecnologias e ferramentas.

• Garantir a aderência aos padrões de segurança, qualidade, escalabilidade e governança de TI.

• Atuar na identificação e mitigação de riscos arquiteturais em projetos e soluções.

• Apoiar a disseminação de boas práticas de arquitetura entre os times de tecnologia.

• Contribuir com a evolução dos frameworks, padrões e diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.

Qualidades técnicas:


• Certificação AZ-900 Microsoft Azure

• Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (MVC, SOA, Microserviços, Event-Driven, entre outros).

• Experiência com APIs, barramento de serviços (ESB), integrações e arquitetura orientada a serviços.

• Conhecimentos em segurança da informação aplicada à arquitetura.

• Domínio de ferramentas de modelagem como Enterprise Architect, Draw.io, ArchiMate, Lucidchart, entre outras.

• Capacidade de definir e aplicar princípios de arquitetura corporativa e governança de TI.


Diferencial desejado:


• Experiência com frameworks TOGAF, ITIL e COBIT.

• Conhecimentos em arquitetura de dados, big data ou analytics.

• Pós-graduação ou MBA em Arquitetura de Soluções, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.

• Vivência com DevOps, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e CI/CD.

• Certificação AZ-305


Qualidades pessoais:


• Pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica.

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir aspectos técnicos para o negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia na busca por soluções.

• Capacidade analítica e foco em resolução de problemas.

• Espírito colaborativo e habilidade para atuar em ambientes multifuncionais.

• Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas técnicas.


Experiência anterior: Experiência com desenho de soluções técnicas, especificação de integrações e apoio a times de desenvolvimento ou infraestrutura. Participação em projetos de médio a grande porte com atuação transversal em áreas de TI. Vivência com modernização de sistemas legados ou implantação de soluções em nuvem.




Habilidades Técnicas:


- Docker

- ARCHIMATE

- SOA

- Kubernetes

- APIs

- MVC

- Microserviços

- Lucidchart

- ZACHMAN

- SAFE

- BIG DATA & ANALYTICS

- GOVERNANCA DE ARQUITETURA

- DIAGRAMAS DE ARQUITETURA

- GOVERNANCA DE TI (COBIT / ITIL)

- FLUXOS DE INTEGRACAO

- EVENT-DRIVEN

- ANÁLISES DE VIABILIDADE

- BARRAMENTO DE SERVIÇOS

- AMBIENTES EM NUVEM

- AWS, AZURE OU GCP

- ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT

- DRAW.IO

- CI/CD

- Microsoft Azure AZ-900


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Pensamento sistêmico

- Organização

- Visão estratégica

- PROATIVIDADE E AUTONOMIA

- Boa comunicação

- Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.


Metodologias:


- AGILIDADE (OU METODOLOGIAS AGEIS)


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto




E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must haves

  • TypeScript proficiency (3+ years)
  • Proficiency with Playwright
  • Experience with Vitest or Jest
  • Experience with React Testing Library
  • Understanding of Page Object Model
  • Experience with REST/RPC API testing
  • Experience with Git and GitHub Actions
  • Experience with monorepo architecture (PNPM workspaces, Turborepo)
  • SQL / database testing fundamentals
  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English, daily communication with US-team members


Nice to have

  • Experience with tRPC
  • Drizzle ORM or similar TypeScript ORM experience
  • Experience with microfrontend architecture
  • Storybook / visual regression testing
  • Accessibility testing automation (axe-core, Playwright accessibility)
  • Experience setting up coverage thresholds and quality gates in CI
  • Familiarity with Zustand and TanStack Query


Key responsibilities

  • Build out and maintain the Playwright E2E test framework (page objects, fixtures, test data management)
  • Write TypeScript-based E2E tests for critical user workflows
  • Establish and enforce coverage thresholds in the CI pipeline
  • Develop API-level integration tests for tRPC endpoints
  • Contribute to the testing strategy across multiple solution packages in the monorepo
  • Work within an agile team alongside developers to ensure testability of new features from design phase

title: Analista de Sistema SR Frontend Angular/REACT/AWS
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • Desenvolver projetos utilizando React Native, Angular, Webview, AWS, Nestjs e Inteligência Artificial.


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst – Fintech Consulting Engagement (Remote | Brazil) 300 Software | Full-time Consulting Role
description:
About the Engagement

300 Software is expanding its presence in the US fintech market through a strategic consulting partnership with an online consumer lending company that provides lines of credit of up to $2,000 to everyday Americans for essential needs like medical, home repair, and unexpected expenses. They serve a broad, non-prime consumer segment, making real credit decisions in under 3 seconds in a data-heavy, high-volume environment where credit model performance directly impacts business outcomes.

This engagement is part of 300 Software's growing fintech practice, where we embed analytical and engineering talent within client operations — bringing Brazilian technical expertise to US financial services companies. The relationship has strong potential to evolve beyond analytics into tool development and deeper platform work.


The Role

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst, you'll work as part of the 300 Software consulting team embedded with the client. This role sits at the intersection of data science, statistical modeling, and credit strategy — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real business impact from day one.

Your core mission is to identify issues inside credit models, analyze loan performance data, and help the team understand whether models are performing in line with expectations — and drive the changes when they're not.


What You'll Do

Monitor and analyze credit model performance, comparing actual loan behavior against model assumptions. Use regression analysis and other statistical and predictive tools to surface insights from performance data. Write complex SQL queries to extract and analyze data from cloud-based data lakes in an AWS environment. Build dashboards and reporting tools to communicate credit risk trends to leadership. Help define which borrower attributes to track and weight in underwriting decisions. Participate in weekly reporting meetings with the US-based team (Central Time Zone, 2 to 3 hour difference from Brazil). Collaborate with engineering and compliance teams to implement credit strategy improvements. Work alongside 300 Software's internal data and infrastructure team, which supports the client's AWS environment and data layer.


What We're Looking For

5 or more years of experience in credit analysis, data analytics, or a related quantitative role. Strong SQL skills including complex queries, data extraction, and reporting. Solid understanding of statistical modeling including regression analysis, predictive modeling, and scorecard development. Experience working with data lakes and cloud environments, with AWS being a plus. Comfort operating independently in a remote setup. Fluent English, as you will be in meetings and communicating directly with the US team. A background in engineering, statistics, or mathematics is a strong plus.


Setup

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: AWS Data Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for AWS Data Architect .


In this role you will:

  • Design and manage AWS-based data infrastructure
  • Build and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant data
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform / CloudFormation
  • Automate deployments, scaling, and operational tasks via CI/CD pipelines
  • Participate in architecture reviews and recommend best practices for AWS data platforms
  • Ensure data security, governance, and compliance (IAM, encryption, VPC, logging)
  • Design and implement monitoring, alerting, and observability for data platforms and pipelines
  • Integrate and manage monitoring tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch
  • Create dashboards, alerts, and SLIs/SLOs to ensure pipeline reliability and performance
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to support analytics use cases
  • Automate deployments, scaling, and operational tasks via CI/CD pipelines


We have some requirements:

  • Proficiency in Python / SQL (Scala optional)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, and distributed systems
  • Experience with Apache Spark, EMR, Kafka
  • Experience with Data Lake
  • Familiarity with Airflow, Step Functions, or other orchestration tools
  • Fluent English


Technology:

  • S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, Kinesis, and RDS
  • Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch
  • AWS

title: Desenvolvedor Angular Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura: Liderar o desenvolvimento de novas soluções frontend, definindo a arquitetura mais adequada e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas de mercado.

Criação de Componentes: Desenvolver componentes de UI reutilizáveis, performáticos e acessíveis, que servirão de base para nossas aplicações.

Colaboração Estratégica: Trabalhar em colaboração direta com designers de UI/UX para garantir a fidelidade e a viabilidade técnica das interfaces, e com engenheiros de backend para definir e consumir APIs.

Qualidade de Código: Promover uma cultura de alta qualidade, escrevendo código bem documentado, implementando testes automatizados e participando ativamente de code reviews.

Performance e Otimização: Monitorar e otimizar continuamente a performance das aplicações para garantir uma experiência de usuário rápida e fluida.


Requisitos Essenciais

Domínio em Frameworks JavaScript: Experiência sênior e profundo conhecimento em Angular. Você deve ser uma referência técnica em pelo menos um desses ecossistemas.

Fundamentos Sólidos: Maestria em HTML5, CSS3, e JavaScript (ES6+), com proficiência em TypeScript.

Ecossistema Moderno: Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack/Vite), gerenciadores de pacotes (NPM/Yarn), e controle de versão com Git.

Integração de APIs: Vasta experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful ou GraphQL.

Testes Automatizados: Experiência prática na implementação de estratégias de testes unitários, de integração e e2e (ex: Jest, Cypress, Jasmine/Karma).

Gerenciamento de Estado: Conhecimento sólido em bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado relevantes para seu framework de domínio (ex: Redux, Zustand, Context API para React; Services, NgRx para Angular).


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento Java


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Java , em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead ), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, ambientes de alta performance e contextos tecnológicos inovadores.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).
