title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Sênior (Databricks)
description:
stamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend com foco em Databricks para atuar em um projeto internacional de alta visibilidade, com foco na construção de aplicações modernas e dashboards de dados.

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver aplicações frontend robustas utilizando Node.js e React , garantindo integração eficiente com a plataforma Databricks Apps e suporte a ambientes orientados a dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React e Node.js
  • Construir aplicações como pacotes deployáveis na plataforma Databricks Apps
  • Desenvolver interfaces para visualização de dados e dashboards interativos
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços e autenticação via Databricks OAuth
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de dados e backend para integração de soluções
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, performance e organização de código
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e colaborar em um ambiente ágil e internacional



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com React.js e Node.js
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações frontend integradas a plataformas de dados
  • Conhecimento em Databricks Apps (deploy de aplicações)
  • Conhecimento em OAuth (preferencialmente Databricks OAuth)
  • Experiência com dashboards de dados / data visualization
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs e integração frontend-backend
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)



Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Databricks
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de dados e analytics
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de visualização (ex: Chart.js, D3.js, Recharts )
  • Experiência no mercado de seguros ou resseguros (re/insurance)



Informações da Vaga

  • Projeto internacional
  • Inglês fluente obrigatório (interação com clientes globais)
  • Modelo: 100% remoto
  • Contratação: PJ

title: Remote Healthcare and Social Assistance Expert - 65107
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for healthcare domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in healthcare, clinical, and administrative settings.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world healthcare and clinical scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Healthcare, Nursing, Administration, Life Sciences, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within healthcare (including but not limited to): Registered Nurses, First-Line Supervisors of Office/Admin Support, Medical & Health Services Managers, Nurse Practitioners, Medical Secretaries & Administrative Assistants.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

  • Write clean, maintainable code and help define best practices.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and propose efficient solutions.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively in a distributed team.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer (ideally in startups or small teams).
  • Strong skills in React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with API integrations and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of design principles, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (C1).
  • Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable working independently.
  • located in Brazil


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-related products or APIs.
  • Knowledge of TypeScript or other modern frameworks.
  • Interest in product thinking and user experience.

title: Analista de Redes Routing & Switching
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Analista de Redes Sênior (Cisco | Routing & Switching | Monitoramento)

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes de rede críticos, garantindo alta disponibilidade e desempenho;
  • Monitorar e analisar a infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix e Grafana;
  • Implementar e manter soluções de automação com Ansible;
  • Administrar e otimizar redes Cisco com foco em Routing & Switching;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes, problemas e melhorias contínuas;
  • Seguir e aplicar padrões, políticas e procedimentos técnicos da operação;
  • Interagir com times internos e, quando necessário, fornecedores internacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de monitoramento e sustentação de tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada com redes Cisco (Routing & Switching);
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Zabbix, Grafana e Ansible;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura, escrita e comunicação);

Diferenciais:

  • Certificação Cisco (CCNA ou CCNP);
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes NOC ou operações críticas;
  • Vivência com automação de redes ou práticas de infraestrutura como código.

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação ou correlatas.


Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: [Vendas] Consultoria de vendas Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Ser referência para entender, demonstrar e validar os requisitos técnicos e comerciais de um determinado produto e/ou serviço TOTVS, a fim de apoiar os canais de distribuição na geração e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócios.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Ter bom conhecimento de um produto ou serviço TOTVS, de baixa complexidade, para realizar demonstrações e validações de requisitos técnicos;
  • Conhecer a política comercial e tabela de preço do produto ou serviço sob seu domínio para apoiar os canais de distribuição TOTVS em suas negociações;
  • Interagir com clientes e/ou prospects, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, por meio dos canais de distribuição TOTVS, para esclarecer suas dúvidas e propor soluções relacionadas ao produto sob seu domínio;
  • Preparar ambientes e sistemas, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, para a realização de demonstrações, eventos e webinars;
  • Demonstrar o produto ou serviço TOTVS sob seu domínio aos clientes e/ou prospects, através do cumprimento do checklist da apresentação, roteiro e processos estabelecidos pela área;
  • Apoiar, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, na execução dos planos táticos de vendas dos canais de distribuição TOTVS;
  • Elaborar relatórios para ESNs e/ou Arquitetos dos projetos, apresentando os pontos relevantes de dúvidas e questionamentos do cliente através de ata da reunião.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação Completa


Conhecimentos:

  • Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Notes) - nível básico;
  • Pacote Google Workspace (Google Forms, Gmail, Drive, Google Sheets, etc.) - nível básico


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

title: Java Programming Analyst
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Backend Sênior

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java Backend para integrar nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores, com alto nível de complexidade e impacto. Se você gosta de construir soluções robustas, escaláveis e bem estruturadas, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java (versões 7 a 21)
  • Criar e evoluir APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot
  • Integrar sistemas por meio de mensageria (RabbitMQ)
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e MySQL)
  • Atuar em projetos de média e alta complexidade, garantindo qualidade e performance
  • Implementar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e observabilidade


Requisitos Técnicos

Linguagens e Frameworks:

  • Java (8 a 21) e manutenção em Java 7
  • Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security

Banco de Dados:

  • Oracle
  • MySQL

Mensageria:

  • RabbitMQ

DevOps e Infraestrutura:

  • Docker
  • Git

Observabilidade:

  • Elastic Stack (Kibana)
  • Grafana
  • Prometheus

Qualidade de Código:

  • Testes unitários com JUnit e Mockito
  • Análise estática com SonarQube

Arquitetura e Integração:

  • WSO2
  • Nomad
  • WebLogic


Formação

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificação Spring Professional
  • Certificações em Cloud/DevOps (AWS, Docker, etc.)
  • Certificações em Arquitetura ou Integração (WSO2, Microservices)


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Backend Sênior

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java Backend para integrar nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores, com alto nível de complexidade e impacto. Se você gosta de construir soluções robustas, escaláveis e bem estruturadas, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java (versões 7 a 21)
  • Criar e evoluir APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot
  • Integrar sistemas por meio de mensageria (RabbitMQ)
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e MySQL)
  • Atuar em projetos de média e alta complexidade, garantindo qualidade e performance
  • Implementar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e observabilidade


Requisitos Técnicos

Linguagens e Frameworks:

  • Java (8 a 21) e manutenção em Java 7
  • Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security

Banco de Dados:

  • Oracle
  • MySQL

Mensageria:

  • RabbitMQ

DevOps e Infraestrutura:

  • Docker
  • Git

Observabilidade:

  • Elastic Stack (Kibana)
  • Grafana
  • Prometheus

Qualidade de Código:

  • Testes unitários com JUnit e Mockito
  • Análise estática com SonarQube

Arquitetura e Integração:

  • WSO2
  • Nomad
  • WebLogic


Formação

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificação Spring Professional
  • Certificações em Cloud/DevOps (AWS, Docker, etc.)
  • Certificações em Arquitetura ou Integração (WSO2, Microservices)


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

#VemPraSIS #SomosSIS

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Sales Manager para atuar junto a um de nossos clientes do setor de Fabricação de produtos químicos. Esta é a função responsável por atingir os objetivos de receita junto à equipe de vendas em nível global, atuando na gestão de equipes, análise de mercado e definição de planos comerciais e de clientes.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Idioma: Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Duração: Indeterminado

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar um plano de vendas internacional e metas (quotas) alinhadas ao plano operacional anual.
  • Gerenciar o desempenho de colaboradores individuais e/ou equipes dedicadas.
  • Analisar ativamente as tendências do mercado global para enfrentar desafios de forma eficiente e aproveitar oportunidades.
  • Manter margens de preço para atingir as metas de rentabilidade.
  • Garantir o mix de produtos com base em receita, volume e margens.
  • Garantir o mix de clientes com base no tipo de stakeholder, proporção de contribuição de receita e fatores de dependência.
  • Atingir metas de receita visando crescimento ideal ano a ano.
  • Monitorar o desempenho de pagamentos na carteira de clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos de aquisição e retenção de clientes para maximizar o valor do ciclo de vida do cliente (CLV).
  • Acompanhar a entrega de serviços técnicos dos produtos em toda a carteira de clientes.
  • Participar de programas de treinamento para equipes globais com base em análise de gaps de competências.
  • Realizar reportes periódicos de vendas e apresentações junto ao vice-presidente.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas e proposição de ações em coordenação com o vice-presidente.
  • Trabalhar em outros projetos comerciais adicionais conforme designado.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente
  • Graduação em química, engenharia química ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência na indústria química.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: SR. Desenvolvimento Mainframe
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento em Alta Plataforma / Mainframe
  • Experiência comprovada em Cobol
  • Experiência em Cobol CICS para aplicações transacionais online
  • Experiência em Natural/Adabas
  • Experiência em JCL para processamento batch
  • Experiência Com DB2
  • Experiência em Sort (DFSORT/SYNCSORT)
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de processos batch e online
  • Conhecimento de VSAM
  • Experiência em análise e tratamento de erros em ambientes produtivos
  • Experiência com ambiente z/OS
  • Conhecimento em integração entre sistemas mainframe e plataformas distribuídas (via arquivos, mensageria ou APIs)
  • Experiência em análise de impacto, correção de incidentes e sustentação de sistemas críticos
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Capacidade de leitura, entendimento e evolução de sistemas legados complexos


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em modernização de sistemas legados (mainframe para baixa plataforma/cloud)
  • Experiência em ambientes financeiros ou bancários
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas híbridas (mainframe + cloud)
  • Vivência em SRE, observabilidade ou monitoração de sistemas críticos
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e apoiar desenvolvedores mais juniores


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Brazil- Remote

Long Term Contract



Job Description:


  • Proven experience in designing and implementing data solutions on the Databricks platform.
  • Solid understanding of Databricks fundamentals/architecture and have hands on experience in setting up Databricks cluster, working in Databricks modules (Data Engineering, ML and SQL warehouse).
  • Create and maintain documentation for data pipelines, processes, and best practices.
  • Knowledge of Performance Optimization, Monitoring and Automation would be a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance, compliance, and security best practices.
  • Knowledge in anyone of the cloud platforms AWS is a must.
  • Strong Proficiency in Pyspark, Databricks Notebooks, SQL, Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Certifications in Databricks would be beneficial.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering best practices, data modeling, Data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest Databricks features and best practices.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

title: AWS AI/ML Architect (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar soluções utilizando serviços da AWS para IA generativa, como Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker.
  • Definir padrões de orquestração de agentes, integração com APIs e workflows corporativos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar AI Agents capazes de executar tarefas, consultas e automações complexas.
  • Construir pipelines de RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) para acesso a dados corporativos.
  • Integrar agentes com sistemas bancários, APIs internas e plataformas digitais.
  • Implementar memória de agentes, ferramentas (tools) e mecanismos de reasoning.
  • Aplicar AI Agents para acelerar desenvolvimento e modernização de aplicações.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Smart Engineering e AI-assisted development.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos de segurança, compliance e governança de dados do setor financeiro.
  • Definir modelos de observabilidade e métricas de performance para agentes de IA.
  • Monitorar qualidade de respostas, latência e custo de inferência.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com Agents Builder / desenvolvimento de AI Agents
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Cloud (AWS)
  • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock e Amazon SageMaker
  • Domínio em RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • conhecimento em MLOps
  • conhecimento em Spring Boot / Java
  • Integração com APIs REST
  • Orquestração de agentes e workflows
  • Implementação de memória, tools e reasoning em agentes de IA
  • Integração com sistemas corporativos e plataformas digitais
  • Observabilidade e monitoramento de IA (qualidade de resposta, latência e custo de inferência)

title: Remote Government Sector Expert - 65106
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for public sector domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in government, policy, and social service domains


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world public sector and policy scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Social Work, Public Administration, Management, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within the public sector (including but not limited to): Child, Family, and School Social Workers, First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives, Recreation Workers, Compliance Officers, Administrative Services Managers.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: Gerente de projetos Oracle
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Projetos Oracle Sênior para atuar em iniciativas de implantação e melhorias de sistemas, com forte interface entre times locais e globais. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança do projeto, liderar rituais, realizar alinhamentos estratégicos e garantir a aderência às diretrizes corporativas.


Responsabilidades

Liderar projetos Oracle relacionados a implantação, melhorias e evolução da plataforma.

Atuar como ponto focal entre o time local e global, garantindo alinhamento contínuo.

Conduzir toda a governança de projetos , incluindo:

  • rituais de acompanhamento,
  • status reports executivos,
  • steering committees.

Gerenciar riscos, issues, mudanças e dependências do projeto.

Estruturar e controlar cronograma, escopo, orçamento e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) .

Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e a aderência às diretrizes globais e padrões corporativos.

Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando o cliente na tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Requisitos

Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos atuando em iniciativas Oracle.

Vivência sólida em governança de PMO : gestão de cronograma, escopo, custos, riscos e stakeholders.

Experiência em ambientes corporativos estruturados e com interação multicultural.

Inglês avançado , com boa comunicação oral e escrita.

Senioridade compatível com atuação estratégica e executiva.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Atuação prévia em projetos com alinhamento ou reporte para times globais.

title: Translator and Project Coordinator
description:
Translator & Project Coordinator


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


We are seeking a bilingual professional to join our Translations Department in a dual-capacity role. The ideal candidate will serve as an in-house Spanish-into-English OR Portuguese-into-English translator, handling daily document translation tasks, while also providing project management support, including covering a Project Manager during periods of absence and independently managing a few translation projects.


This position is well suited to someone who combines strong linguistic precision with organizational skills and a solid understanding of certified translation standards for immigration, legal, and official documentation.


Key Responsibilities:

-Translation (Primary Function)

  • Translate Spanish-language OR Portuguese-language documents into English on a daily basis, including birth certificates, marriage certificates, diplomas, academic transcripts, identification documents, legal contracts, and immigration records.
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and appropriate register across all document types.
  • Apply quality assurance procedures, including self-review and adherence to departmental style guides.
  • Assist with post-editing machine-translated content (MTPE) when applicable.


-Project Coordination (Secondary Function)

  • Act as the primary point of contact for project management duties when a Project Manager is out of office.
  • Manage translation projects from intake to delivery, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Coordinate with translators, reviewers, and external vendors; assign tasks and track progress.
  • Monitor project timelines, communicate status updates to clients, and flag potential delays proactively.


Requirements:

-Education & Language

  • Bachelor's degree in Translation, Linguistics, Spanish OR Portuguese, or a related field (required).
  • Near-native or native proficiency in Spanish OR Portuguese (required); native or near-native English proficiency (required).
  • Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, fluent certified translations for official use.


-Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of professional translation experience, specifically Spanish-to-English OR Portuguese-to-English.


-Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to translation accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication in English.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and PDF tools (e.g., Adobe Acrobat).


What We Offer:

  • A structured, professional environment within an established certified translation company.
  • Exposure to a wide variety of document types, languages, and complex translation challenges.
  • A clear dual-track career path combining linguistic expertise and project management.
  • Collaborative team culture with experienced PMs and senior translators.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Analista de qualidade sênior
description:
Analista de Qualidade Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e

proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como QA Sênior você será referência estratégica e técnica dentro da Squad, além da confiabilidade de nossos produtos. Liderando a estratégia de qualidade, definindo processos que antecipam riscos e garantem entregas de alto impacto. Será responsável por colaborar com

Tech Leads e Arquitetos para integrar a qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida do software (SDLC). Além de dominar testes manuais e automatizados, atuará como mentor do time, disseminando boas práticas, otimizando a base de conhecimento e elevando o padrão técnico da organização.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar scripts e frameworks de testes automatizados para aumentar a eficiência do ciclo de entrega;
  • Atuar como referência técnica (mentor) para desenvolvedores e QAs menos experientes, apoiando decisões junto a Tech Leads e Arquitetos;
  • Planejar e executar testes funcionais, integrados, regressão e performance, garantindo que os requisitos do projeto sejam atendidos integralmente;
  • Estruturar a documentação de módulos e funcionalidades na Base de Conhecimento, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a confiabilidade dos testes;
  • Identificar gargalos nos processos de desenvolvimento e implementar métricas de qualidade para monitorar a saúde do produto.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência na área da Qualidade de Software. (experiência mínima de 5 anos);
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Domínio em ferramentas de automação (Playwright, Cypress ou equivalentes);
  • Conhecimento em Postgres e linguagem SQL para a realização de consultas e validação de dados;
  • Experiência prática em testes de APIs (REST/SOAP) com Postman, SoapUI, Insomnia ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência com testes Mobile;
  • Experiência em linguagem de Programação (JavaScript, Typescript);
  • Conhecimento em padrões de projetos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Observabilidade (Grafana, DataDog ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD como Gitlab.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Vivência na integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de deploy contínuo;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de testes de desempenho como JMeter, Gatling ou k6;
  • Noções de testes de vulnerabilidades e segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e uso de IA generativa;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria;
  • Possuir certificações como CTFL (ISTQB), CTAL ou especializações em Automação de Testes.



Por que #VemParaSyonet? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente.

title: Especialista SRE
description:
Título do Cargo: Especialista SRE

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente e proativo(a) para atuar como Especialista SRE em uma empresa de tecnologia líder no setor. Nesta função, você contribuirá com a evolução e padronização da ferramenta Azure DevOps, a sustentação e automação de ambientes baseados em Kubernetes, e a gestão de infraestrutura cloud e on-premises.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar e customizar Work Item Types, Process Templates, Workflows e Rules no Azure DevOps.

title: ASM Team Lead
description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the ASM team in daily coordination, prioritization, and escalation management.
  • Conduct triage for high visibility incidents, ensuring clear and timely communication with IT and Business.
  • Prioritize incidents and changes together with Business teams and IT capabilities.
  • Manage multi-vendor relationships, ensuring high performance and delivery quality.
  • Review ticket flow per portfolio and monitor RCA, weekly meetings, and performance metrics.
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements to accelerate resolution.
  • Perform code reviews and validate release packages and installation plans.
  • Coordinate operational artifacts: Stability Assessment, knowledge documents, KEDB, and Service Delivery reports.
  • Actively participate in Command Center and Incident/Problem/RCA Management forums.
  • Lead productivity initiatives and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with processes and controls, applying ITIL/ SDLC best practices.
  • Present monthly results (KPIs/SLAs) to IT and Business leadership.
  • Support operational activities when necessary.


Success Indicators (KPIs)

  • Application availability and stability (uptime).
  • MTTR reduction and incident recurrence reduction.
  • SLA/SLO performance.
  • Change quality (low rollback/post release incident rate).
  • Operational efficiency: backlog reduction, productivity improvements, automation.
  • Internal customer satisfaction (IT/Business).


Mandatory Requirements

  • 8+ years leading IT solution delivery (ASM, AMS, Application Operations, or related fields).
  • Proven experience in critical incident management, prioritization, and executive communication.
  • Experience with multi-vendor environments and enterprise ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft).
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge) and SDLC.
  • Ability to mentor teams, run operational ceremonies, and present operational metrics.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (Computer Science, Systems, Engineering, Business/Finance).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora

description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Data Analyst


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.


Responsibilities

  • Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking.
  • Write and optimize SQL for analysis, reporting, and data validation.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and merchant trends to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Investigate anomalies, data issues, and performance changes across key metrics.
  • Partner with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to answer business questions with data.
  • Work with existing pipelines and datasets to improve trust, consistency, and usability of data.
  • Use Python for analysis, validation, and lightweight automation where needed.
  • Support data quality efforts by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases in source data.
  • Create clear visualizations and communicate findings in a practical, business-friendly way.
  • Work within the current stack (MySQL, AWS, Airflow; ClickHouse is a plus).


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports.
  • Ability to translate business questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience working with production data and validating data quality.
  • Python proficiency for analysis or automation.
  • Strong communication and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.


Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data.
  • Experience with Airflow or other scheduled workflow tools.
  • AWS experience.
  • Observability/visualization experience (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior ClickHouse experience.
  • Basic Linux/CLI comfort.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Salesforce Configuration Specialist
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Salesforce Configuration Specialist to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the chance to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation
  • Build reports and dashboards for operational and leadership insights


Required Experience

  • Solid experience with Salesforce administration and configuration (not only certifications)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • User management (roles, profiles, permission sets, security policies)
  • Data modeling and object relationships
  • Validation rules, formula fields, record types, list views
  • Flows (advanced level) and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SSO/SAML configuration and authentication setup
  • Proficiency in Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and data quality management
  • Ability to differentiate data vs. configuration issues and replicate scenarios in sandbox environments
  • Experience building reports and dashboards


Preferred Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication skills in English (client-facing environment)
  • Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach
  • Experience in B2B software environments


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, or ISV development
  • Experience writing technical specifications


Why Join

  • Work on international projects with global clients
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale Salesforce environments
  • Collaborative and technically driven team


If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com (Salesforce Funcional).

title: 11178 - Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando um Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para atuar alocado em empresa do setor de saúde, especializada na administração de planos e benefícios. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções Full Stack, contribuindo para a entrega de produtos digitais com qualidade, estabilidade, escalabilidade e alinhamento às necessidades do negócio! ✨


Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida em Node.js , com foco no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful .
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços .
  • Sólido domínio de Domain-Driven Design (DDD ).
  • Experiência com integração de serviços e APIs externas.
  • Conhecimento em Git e boas práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Experiência com SQL Server , incluindo modelagem relacional e construção de queries.
  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript e desenvolvimento de aplicações web.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks ou bibliotecas modernas (Vue, React, Angular ou similares ).
  • Aplicação de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de interfaces, componentização e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum, Kanban ou similares.


Diferencias (Não eliminatório):

  • Experiência com testes automatizados (front-end e back-end).
  • Conhecimento em mensageria e integrações assíncronas.
  • Vivência com containers e ambientes em cloud.
  • Experiência atuando como referência técnica ou apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros profissionais.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados em grafo (Neo4j).
  • Experiência com MongoDB, incluindo modelagem e consultas.


Soft Skills:

  • Perfil sênior, com autonomia, responsabilidade e visão sistêmica.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e foco na resolução de problemas.
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade de colaboração com diferentes áreas.
  • Comprometimento com qualidade, prazos e melhoria contínua.
  • Visão orientada ao impacto das soluções no negócio e perfil curioso, com interesse constante em aprender e evoluir.


Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter soluções Full Stack, atuando no back-end e front-end das aplicações.
  • Criar e evoluir APIs RESTful utilizando Node.js e JavaScript, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver interfaces e componentes de front-end, garantindo usabilidade, performance e boa experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de novos projetos e na manutenção corretiva e evolutiva de sistemas existentes.
  • Realizar integrações com serviços internos e APIs de terceiros, assegurando confiabilidade e segurança.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planejamento, refinamento, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software, como DDD, versionamento de código, revisão de código e padronização.
  • Contribuir para decisões técnicas e evolução da arquitetura das soluções.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de Produto, Negócio, Qualidade, Infraestrutura e Segurança.
  • Garantir que as entregas estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade, segurança e governança da empresa.
